description: This file defines authentication route handlers for user registration and login in an Express application. It handles creating new users and authenticating existing users, returning JSON Web Tokens (JWT) and user information.

methods.name: authRouter.post('/register')
methods.description: Handles user registration, validates input, checks for existing email, hashes password, creates user, and returns token and user info.

methods.name: authRouter.post('/login')
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials, compares password hash, and returns JWT and user info upon success.
